proof_scope: I-model curves have I-model initial/terminal potentials. Ordinary and ideal projection in semipositive enlarged backgrounds gives curves with projected bases. Smooth cohomologous changes and proper modifications between compact Kähler manifolds preserve masses/energies and all bounded/finite-energy/I-model subclasses. Bounded multiplicative filtrations on a big line bundle give bounded I-model curves/rays via normalized section suprema. Their initial tail is identified by the internal section asymptotic formulas before using interior positivity; this avoids circular positivity. A finite numerical superadditive argument identifies the critical slope. Smooth metric independence and an explicit parity endpoint example are included. No Skoda division, external projectivity or pointwise degree-limit theorem imported.
